channel.title: Clearway
channel.description: Most recent changes with links to updates.

item.title: Version 4.4.0
item.description:
* A task or subtask with an open question now shows the question as a one-line scrolling banner on the board and in the task's subtask list. It replaces the dot, so you can see what the task is waiting on. * The Dock icon shows how many questions are open across your projects. It bounces until you switch to Clearway, and bounces again when a new question arrives. * Board cards have a new layout: each task's key now sits above its title, and the line under the title only appears when the task has links. The agent dots now run the full height of each card and subtask row, and the spacing is more even.
[v4.4.0 on GitHub](https://github.com/bvalentino/clearway-releases/releases/tag/v4.4.0)

item.title: Version 4.3.0
item.description:
* Tasks and subtasks can now block each other, and chips on cards, subtask rows and the task sheet show what blocks a task and what it blocks. You add blocks from the task sheet or with `cway task block` and `cway task unblock`, and a block counts as resolved once the blocking task is done. * A task can link the git worktree it's worked in, set with `cway task link-worktree` and shown on the task sheet and as a folder mark on the card. Run Prompt runs in that worktree while it still exists, and the agent skill tells agents to link a worktree as soon as they create one. * The task sheet now has its own Activity section that lists each prompt run in Rex with the exact prompt text. A Show in Rex button opens the Rex session while it's still open, and project Activity gains a Runs filter. * The task sheet's ⋯ menu has a new Show in Rex item that brings Rex to the front on the session working on the task. The item is hidden when Rex has no such session open. * Run Prompt now opens a new tab in the task's open Rex session and only creates a new session when none is open. New sessions are named after the task's key and title. * The agent indicator no longer shows on tasks that are done. * The agent skill now tells agents that hand a task to a subagent to have it run `cway task show` on that task first, so the task shows the agent indicator.
[v4.3.0 on GitHub](https://github.com/bvalentino/clearway-releases/releases/tag/v4.3.0)

item.title: Version 4.2.0
item.description:
* Agents can report how far along a task is with `cway task set-progress` and remove the report with `cway task clear-progress`, and the agent skill teaches them to do it. Cards, subtask rows and the task panel show the report as a progress bar, which stays through In Review and clears when the task moves to Done. * A dropped card or subtask row now shows in its new place as soon as you release it, instead of after a short delay. A card or row released over the task panel's text fields is no longer accepted there. * Each board column keeps its scroll position while Activity is open, so going back to the board no longer returns every column to the top. * A `cway` change that was saved no longer reports a failure because a different task in the project can't be read, so agents don't retry changes that already went through. `cway` error messages now name tasks by their key. * Dragging a card onto another project's window no longer moves a task there. * After a failed New Task write, a successful retry now clears the earlier error, so the alert no longer shows an error for a task that was saved. * The Archive All… prompt no longer counts a hand-nested subtask twice, so the number it shows matches what gets archived. * A repository opened from the Trash keeps its project even when it has no Clearway id in its Git settings, and its old location keeps its path when the folder is put back. * Renaming a project to its folder's name now works even with extra spaces, and the board shows the name exactly as it was saved. An invalid stored project key no longer causes an error, and the app uses the key it works out from the project instead. * The Command Line Tools row in setup no longer switches from Installed back to Install when an older check finishes late. * Stopping an agent now always clears its subagent records, so a later `cway` run is not credited to a subagent that already stopped.
[v4.2.0 on GitHub](https://github.com/bvalentino/clearway-releases/releases/tag/v4.2.0)

item.title: Version 4.1.0
item.description:
* Any folder can now be a project, not only a git repository, and the New Project button opens a folder picker. Inside a plain folder, `cway` uses the nearest listed project folder, and removing a plain folder from the sidebar keeps its tasks. * Every install gets a Default project at your home folder once, and it opens on that first launch. Opening it never asks you to install Apple's Command Line Tools. * You can drag a card to a chosen spot within its lane or into another lane, and the lane opens a space where it will land. * You can drag subtasks in the task panel to reorder them, and a line shows where the row will land. * The board keeps the order of tasks, and `cway task reorder` lets agents move a task to the top or bottom of its lane or before or after another task. `cway task list` prints tasks in board order, and JSON output now includes each task's place. * You can rename a project from its sidebar menu, and the new name shows in the sidebar, toolbar, Inbox and notifications. * Parallel subagents in one Claude Code session now each keep their own task lit on the board. Existing installs are offered an Update to get the new hook setup. * Switching to another app now saves a New Task you have typed into, and your caret is still in place when you come back. * When the archived view is filtered by search, Delete All Archived… deletes only the cards the search shows, and its confirmation counts only those. * The board keeps its sideways scroll position when you leave Activity or open a task from it. * Clicking anywhere in the description area, including its margins or below the text, now puts the caret in the description. * Clearway no longer imports task files from versions before 4.0.
[v4.1.0 on GitHub](https://github.com/bvalentino/clearway-releases/releases/tag/v4.1.0)

item.title: Version 4.0.0
item.description:
* Each board's ⋯ menu has Show Activity, which lists every change in the project by day, newest first. It shows whether you, an agent or GitHub made each change, updates live, and lets you filter, search and open a change's task. * Tasks and questions now live in an app database that the app and `cway` share, and your existing task and question files are imported once. Copy File Path is removed, and task and question output from `cway` no longer includes a path. * You can link a task to the issue it tracks with `cway task link-issue` and remove the link with `cway task unlink-issue`. The task shows its linked issue in the app, and `cway` prints it too. * `cway search` finds tasks and questions by their text, including archived tasks, with `--limit` and `--json` options. The agent skill now tells agents to use it. * A subtask can become a top-level task with Convert to Task… in its ⋯ menu or with `cway task convert-to-task`. It keeps everything except its parent. * When you switch away from Clearway, the open task's unsaved title and description are saved right away, so agents see your latest text. Quitting also saves a changed title, and offers Retry or Quit Anyway if that save fails. * In New Task, pressing Tab from the title now keeps focus in the description. Shift-Tab in any task's description moves focus back to the title.
[v4.0.0 on GitHub](https://github.com/bvalentino/clearway-releases/releases/tag/v4.0.0)

item.title: Version 3.9.0
item.description:
* New tasks save themselves, so there is no Create or Cancel button. Leaving the panel, switching projects or quitting keeps the task, and a task with no title shows as Untitled. * The board's toolbar has a search field that filters the cards by task title and key, and ⌘F focuses it. While a search is active, Archive All… and Unarchive All act only on the cards shown. * The board scrolls up and down again while a task is open.
[v3.9.0 on GitHub](https://github.com/bvalentino/clearway-releases/releases/tag/v3.9.0)

item.title: Version 3.8.0
item.description:
* Each board column now has a + button that creates a new task directly in that column's status. Its ⋯ menu can archive every card in the column, or unarchive them all in the archived view. * In the task sheet, clicking the status icon next to the title opens a menu to change the task's status, and running or copying the prompt is now an icon in the header. Buttons inside the sheet are now plain bordered buttons instead of white glass chips. * Reading a task with `cway task show` or `cway question show` now highlights it for 60 seconds instead of making it the session's task, so reading another task no longer redirects the session's work. * The agent skill now tells agents to ask every question about a Clearway task with `cway question ask`, so questions reach the task and the Inbox. Agents ask independent questions at the same time and hold back a question until any question it depends on is answered. * Unsaved edits in the task sheet are now saved before the task is archived or deleted, so they are no longer lost or applied out of order. * Option previews with box-drawing characters now draw solid vertical lines instead of dashed ones, and every row starts at the left instead of being centered.
[v3.8.0 on GitHub](https://github.com/bvalentino/clearway-releases/releases/tag/v3.8.0)

item.title: Version 3.7.0
item.description:
* Tasks and New Task now open in a panel that floats over the board instead of a sheet, so the board stays usable and clicking another card switches the panel to that task. Close the panel with its X button or Esc, and a New Task draft or a reply you were typing stays when you click away. * You can archive a task to take it off the board without losing it, and a toolbar menu switches the board to show archived tasks, where you can unarchive or delete them. In `cway`, `task archive` and `task unarchive` replace `task delete`, and deleting a task in the app is now permanent. * Tasks now have short keys made of the project key and a number, such as CLWY-12, shown on cards and in the task panel and accepted by every `cway` command. You can change a project's key with Change Key… on its sidebar row. * Agents can attach a text preview, such as a mockup, code or a diagram, to each option of a question with `cway question ask --preview`. The preview appears inside the option's button, and after you answer it also appears under the answer. * Long answer options in a question now wrap onto several lines instead of being cut off.
[v3.7.0 on GitHub](https://github.com/bvalentino/clearway-releases/releases/tag/v3.7.0)

item.title: Version 3.6.0
item.description:
* The board has a new layout: lanes run the full height of the window and each scrolls its own cards, while the board scrolls only sideways. The project name, or "Inbox", now appears as the toolbar title, with **+** at the end of the toolbar. * Card and subtask titles now wrap instead of being cut off, and a pull request shows as an outlined chip below the title. * A card being worked on by an agent now shows two columns of fading dots beside its title instead of a glowing border, and the card keeps its size. With Reduce Motion on, the dots hold still. * Status icons now have colors: yellow for In Progress, green for In Review and indigo for Done. * The task sheet's ⋯ menu has a new Copy Task ID item.
[v3.6.0 on GitHub](https://github.com/bvalentino/clearway-releases/releases/tag/v3.6.0)

item.title: Version 3.5.0
item.description:
* The reply field for a question, in both the task sheet and the Inbox, now grows with your reply up to five lines and then scrolls. Option-Return adds a new line and Return sends.
[v3.5.0 on GitHub](https://github.com/bvalentino/clearway-releases/releases/tag/v3.5.0)

item.title: Version 3.4.0
item.description:
* ⌘N and the toolbar + now open a New Task sheet with a title and a description, and nothing is saved until you click Create. Cancel asks before throwing away anything you typed, and after Create the task's full sheet opens in its place. * A task's description is now always-editable Markdown that is styled as you type, so a click puts the caret where you click. Clicking a link opens it, and pasting inserts plain text. * The board, sidebar, task sheet and Inbox follow the new design more closely, and the sheet header, artifact pills and question options are now system-drawn buttons (Liquid Glass on macOS 26). The In Progress and In Review status icons have a new look. * Settings and the Setup sheet are laid out like System Settings and share one width, so the window no longer changes width between tabs. The Prompts tab lists your prompts on the left and shows the selected prompt's name and text on the right. * In Prompts settings, a new prompt starts with an empty name showing a grey Untitled placeholder, and its text shows a Prompt placeholder. The − button is disabled when no prompt is selected, and No Prompts and No Prompt Selected now show as larger centered titles. * On board cards, subtask rows without an open question now reach the card's edge, which gives their titles more room. The line between subtask rows is slightly thicker. * In a task sheet, an empty title shows a Title placeholder, Done is medium weight and the Send arrow is a little smaller. In a subtask's sheet, the parent task's name has more room above the title. * Inline code in a heading is now 13 pt, the same as in body text, and the description's placeholder hides while you edit it.
[v3.4.0 on GitHub](https://github.com/bvalentino/clearway-releases/releases/tag/v3.4.0)

item.title: Version 3.3.0
item.description:
* Commands are now called prompts, and a prompt can run in a new Rex session in its project or be copied, chosen in the Prompts settings tab. Hold ⌥ to copy a prompt instead of running it. * A board with only a few tasks now stays at the top of the window instead of sitting in the middle.
[v3.3.0 on GitHub](https://github.com/bvalentino/clearway-releases/releases/tag/v3.3.0)

item.title: Version 3.2.0
item.description:
* The board has two new columns, Backlog at the far left and In Review, and `cway task set-status` accepts both new statuses. The agent skill tells agents to set In Review while a pull request waits on review, and to move Backlog tasks only when you ask. * Agents can delete a task and its subtasks with `cway task delete`, and only when you ask or to remove their own mistakes. Tasks deleted from `cway` or the app go to a trash, where you can recover them for 30 days. * Agents can withdraw a question that is no longer needed with `cway question withdraw`. A withdrawn question stays in the task's thread marked "Withdrawn", and it leaves the Inbox, badges and notifications. * You can write your own named prompts in a new Commands tab in Settings. The Run Command menu on a task's sheet copies one of these prompts, with the task's id and title filled in. * The Hooks row in Setup now updates as soon as the Command Line Tool is installed, and it says what it needs first.
[v3.2.0 on GitHub](https://github.com/bvalentino/clearway-releases/releases/tag/v3.2.0)

item.title: Version 3.1.0
item.description:
* The board shows which tasks an agent is working on with a softly glowing outline, and hovering shows the agent's name. To turn it on, install the Claude Code hooks from the new Hooks row in Setup or Settings; Codex agents don't show yet. * A task's description is always editable: click it to edit the Markdown in place, and it saves on its own when you click away, press Esc, close the sheet or switch tasks. If an agent changed it in the meantime or the save fails, you're asked what to keep, so your edits aren't lost silently. * Empty board columns now fill their full width, and you can drop a card anywhere in an empty column instead of only on its header.
[v3.1.0 on GitHub](https://github.com/bvalentino/clearway-releases/releases/tag/v3.1.0)

item.title: Version 3.0.1
item.description:
* Clearway now has its own app icon, showing four lanes with a chevron. Version 3.0.0 shipped with a blank placeholder icon.
[v3.0.1 on GitHub](https://github.com/bvalentino/clearway-releases/releases/tag/v3.0.1)

item.title: Version 3.0.0
item.description:
* Clearway opens in one window with a sidebar of your projects and a board for each one, with To Do, In Progress and Done columns. The board updates live as tasks change. * Clicking a task opens its sheet, where you can edit the title and description, change the status, copy details or delete the task. You can also drag cards between columns to change their status, and ⌘N creates a new task. * Agents can create, list and show tasks with the `cway task` commands, and can change a task's title, status or description. Every command can return JSON, and tasks stay out of your git commits. * Agents can ask you a question about a task with `cway question ask` and wait for your reply. You answer in the task sheet by picking an option or writing your own reply. * A new Inbox gathers every waiting question across your projects so you can answer them in one place. Projects with open questions get an orange dot, and the Dock badge and notifications tell you when a question is waiting. * Tasks can have subtasks, one level deep. They appear inside the parent's card on the board and in the task sheet. * Agents can attach Markdown and HTML files to a task with `cway task attach`. They show in the task sheet and open in Quick Look. * A task can be linked to a GitHub pull request with `cway task link-pr`, and the board shows its live state using your `gh` command. Clicking the pull request opens it in your browser. * A Set Up Clearway sheet on first launch, also available in Settings, installs the `cway` command and the agent skill for Claude Code and Codex. When it can, it installs `cway` without asking for an admin password, so it also works on Macs without admin rights. * Clearway now updates itself with signed updates, and Check for Updates… is in the app menu. * Tasks from Clearway Terminal are imported automatically the first time a project loads or `cway` runs. The original files are kept, not deleted.
[v3.0.0 on GitHub](https://github.com/bvalentino/clearway-releases/releases/tag/v3.0.0)
